blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Saturday criticized the impeachment prosecution panel for depending on speculation and deceptive public comments. This development comes as the defense readies its case for the resumption of the Senate impeachment trial on Monday, November 9.
